_comment: Talia the Merchant wants a sample of local goods for buyers upriver. Demonstrates the gather_types objective type: no fixed source is dictated, any mix of the required materials from wherever the player finds them completes it.

greeting.text: Well met! Looking to buy or sell? I've got wares from up and down the river.

choices.text: Do you need anything gathered from around here?

offer.text: As it happens, yes. Buyers upriver want a sample of what this region grows and cuts -- some wild herbs, and a piece of good softwood. Bring me both, from wherever you find them, and I'll pay for your trouble.

in_progress.text: Still need that sample of herbs and softwood, whenever you have a moment.
